name: Blood Moon
summary: The main world event: everything with fangs grows stronger.

sections.heading: During a Blood Moon
sections.body:
- All werewolves and vampires, NPCs included, are much stronger.
- Killing NPCs gives more XP.
- NPCs turn hostile and may attack players.

sections.heading: When
sections.body: The timing is unknown. Several hours can pass between one Blood Moon and the next.
